For ordinary 2500–3500mAh 18650 cells, 1A charging is a sensible default, provided the cell manufacturer permits it. Faster charging is not always better for battery longevity.

One question: Do you mainly want to charge 18650 batteries, or do you also want to test their actual capacity (mAh) and health? That changes which charger I'd recommend.
